description: Use when setting up a new repo, onboarding an existing repo to darkmatter standards, running a compliance check, or when the user says "set up this repo", "bring repo up to standards", "apply template", or "audit repo". Checks and installs the org TypeScript toolchain (Bun catalog, Effect 4, effect-agent, effect-orpc, Postgres-first data, tsgo, oxlint/oxfmt, Vitest, vite-plus, React 19, shadcn), Nix flake-parts devshell, ops/ surface, CI pipeline, and AGENTS.md conventions.
